title: Discourse triangle
blurb: Three agents. Each private stalk is R² (belief). The shared channel is R¹ (what can be said). Expression is projection onto the first coordinate. Alice and Bob say nearly the same number and still disagree on the hidden coordinate — residual is candor, not graph distance.

levels.label: Private
levels.blurb: Pinned opinions. Diffuse must not move these.

levels.label: Said
levels.blurb: The discourse space. A global section here is public consensus.

nodes.title: Alice
nodes.summary: Believes the public claim (coord 0) and a strong private qualifier (coord 1).

nodes.title: Bob
nodes.summary: Says almost the same as Alice. Private coordinate has the opposite sign.

nodes.title: Cara
nodes.summary: Does not endorse the public claim. Private coordinate is quiet.

nodes.title: Public channel
nodes.summary: Unknown utterance. Harmonic extension should land near Alice/Bob's expressed coordinate if Cara is outnumbered — and the Alice–Bob seam stays loud on the hidden axis, which this channel cannot see.

edges.note: Bob says coord 0 only. Private disagreement with Alice is invisible here.
Cara's public dissent is visible; it pulls the channel down.
